artworks.title: Sthenelos bandaging the wounded finger of Diomedes
artworks.description: Wellcome ink drawing after a Chalcidian neck-amphora: Sthenelus binds Diomedes' wounded finger — Capaneus' son as the comrade who tends the Argive champion in the Iliad's orbit.

artworks.title: Sthenelos and Diomedes
artworks.description: Nineteenth-century Baumeister plate of Sthenelus with Diomedes — the Epigone and chariot-mate whose Iliadic vaunt answers Agamemnon with Capaneus' son's pride.
